findings.risk: No ACL or public access block is configured, meaning the bucket defaults to public or permissive access, exposing potentially sensitive data to the internet
findings.remediation: Add acl = "private" to the bucket resource and add an aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block resource with block_public_acls = true, block_public_policy = true, ignore_public_acls = true, and restrict_public_buckets = true

findings.risk: Without an aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block, ACL or bucket policy changes could inadvertently expose the bucket and its objects to the public internet
findings.remediation: Add an aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block resource referencing this bucket with all four attributes (block_public_acls, block_public_policy, ignore_public_acls, restrict_public_buckets) set to true

findings.risk: Data at rest is stored unencrypted, meaning anyone with access to the underlying storage or who obtains the objects can read sensitive data in plaintext
findings.remediation: Add a server_side_encryption_configuration block with a rule specifying apply_server_side_encryption_by_default using sse_algorithm = "aws:kms" and a dedicated KMS key

findings.risk: Without access logging, there is no audit trail of requests made to the bucket, making it impossible to detect unauthorized access or data exfiltration
findings.remediation: Add a logging block pointing target_bucket to the aws_s3_bucket.logs bucket and set an appropriate target_prefix

findings.risk: Without versioning, objects can be permanently deleted or overwritten with no ability to recover previous versions, increasing the impact of accidental or malicious deletion
findings.remediation: Add a versioning block with enabled = true to the bucket resource

findings.issue: Sensitive file uploaded without server-side encryption
findings.risk: The file customer-master.xlsx (likely containing PII or financial data) is stored without object-level encryption, exposing it if the bucket or underlying storage is compromised
findings.remediation: Add server_side_encryption = "aws:kms" and kms_key_id = "<kms_key_arn>" attributes to the aws_s3_bucket_object resource to enforce per-object encryption

findings.risk: Without an aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block, a misconfigured ACL or bucket policy could expose financial data to the public internet despite the private ACL setting
findings.remediation: Add an aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block resource referencing this bucket with block_public_acls, block_public_policy, ignore_public_acls, and restrict_public_buckets all set to true

findings.risk: Financial data stored in this bucket is unencrypted at rest, violating common compliance requirements (PCI-DSS, SOC2) and exposing data if storage media is compromised
findings.remediation: Add a server_side_encryption_configuration block with apply_server_side_encryption_by_default using sse_algorithm = "aws:kms" and a dedicated KMS key

findings.risk: No audit trail exists for access to financial data, preventing detection of unauthorized reads, exfiltration, or compliance reporting
findings.remediation: Add a logging block with target_bucket pointing to aws_s3_bucket.logs and an appropriate target_prefix

findings.risk: Financial records can be permanently deleted or overwritten without recovery options, increasing risk from ransomware, accidental deletion, or insider threats
findings.remediation: Add a versioning block with enabled = true to the bucket resource

findings.remediation: Add an aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block resource referencing this bucket with block_public_acls, block_public_policy, ignore_public_acls, and restrict_public_buckets all set to true

findings.risk: The logging bucket has no aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block. If exposed publicly, access logs could reveal internal resource names, IP addresses, and access patterns useful to an attacker
findings.remediation: Add an aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block resource referencing this bucket with block_public_acls, block_public_policy, ignore_public_acls, and restrict_public_buckets all set to true

findings.issue: S3 access logging not enabled for the logging bucket itself
findings.risk: The logging bucket has no access logging configured for itself, creating a blind spot where access to log data is unaudited and tampering with logs could go undetected
findings.remediation: Configure the logs bucket to log to a separate dedicated audit bucket, or at minimum enable logging to itself with a distinct prefix to maintain a complete audit trail
